title: Temperature Scaling + Shot-Zone Features: Path from 0.221 to sub-0.21 Brier
hypothesis: Current fleet best 0.22062 can break 0.21 by combining: (1) temperature scaling calibration post-processing on tree ensemble outputs, (2) shot-zone spatial features (5 zones x home/away x season/last10), (3) CPU-safe stacked ensemble (extra_trees + rf + xgboost with LogReg meta-learner).

evidence.finding: CNN achieves Brier 0.221, LogReg 0.199, XGBoost 0.202 — calibration + feature quality, not model complexity, is the bottleneck
Stacked ensemble (NB + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGBoost + DT + LR) outperforms all single models for NBA prediction
MC-dropout RNN + rolling-form indicators + spatial shot-chart embeddings yields calibrated sequential probabilities for NBA
TimeSeriesSplit + calibration heads essential for temporal NBA data — isotonic/temperature scaling improve Brier significantly

implementation_steps.detail: New category: spatial_shot_zones — 5 zones (paint, mid-range, corner-3, above-break-3, free-throw) x home/away x season/last10 = 20 raw features. Needs NBA shot-chart data source.

implementation_steps.action: Implement temperature scaling in features/engine.py calibration wrapper
implementation_steps.detail: Post-hoc calibration: learn scalar T on held-out calibration fold. Apply sigmoid(logit(p)/T) to all probability outputs. T in [0.5, 2.0], learned via minimize(binary_crossentropy). No GPU needed, 1 parameter.

implementation_steps.action: Add stacking crossover variant to GA
implementation_steps.detail: When two parents have different model_types (e.g. extra_trees x xgboost), offspring can be a StackingClassifier with the parents as base learners and LogisticRegression(C=0.1) as meta-learner. Cap at 10% of crossover ops to avoid population drift.

implementation_steps.action: Test on S18 (healthiest island, gen 1798 brier 0.22248)
implementation_steps.detail: S18 is currently the live best with stagnation 0. Ideal candidate for feature injection + calibration test. Inject via /api/config or wait for next mutation cycle.

notes: Temperature scaling is a post-hoc wrapper — does not change model training
Shot-zone features are additive to existing 7213 feature candidates
Stacking crossover is opt-in variant — existing crossover ops unchanged
All CPU-safe: no neural networks required

cross_project_applicability.political_alpha: Temperature scaling directly applicable to POL islands (same sklearn stack). POL current best 0.24902 could reach 0.23 with calibration.
